machine.label: Depot CI (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor)

typescript_reference.note: nightly built from b85298b6 + one CI-only commit (9adc871f); b85298b6 is the TypeScript commit tsrs ports (Cargo.toml [workspace.metadata.typescript]). Run only when tsgo and tsrs report different errors, to tell a TypeScript version difference from a tsrs bug.

ordering: sequential compiler batches; compiler order alternates between project/mode pairs
validation: untimed preflight and final output; every measured exit code must match preflight
